id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_040.pack|cs_: "This is the historic Field of Discipline. It has stood since the Age of Heroes, soaked with the blood and sweat of trainees.
"Like all princes of Dundrasil, you were meant to train here under Grand Master Pang.
"I brought you here so you could tread this ground of tradition that stretches back to Erdwin's time.
"Your grandfather, Lord Robert, also trained here, and his achievements remain in everyone's memory.
"Grand Master Pang is famously harsh. This is the Naughty Stick, used to paddle disciples' bottoms.
"In six years of training, Lord Robert had his bottom paddled with it ten thousand times!
"That record still stands, and the warning 'Don't be like Robert' is passed down to this day.
"{var:1}, are you worried about Lord Robert? He endured the Grand Master's harsh training and is a legendary disciple.
"He is not so frail as to die from the world's collapse. I'm sure he's safe somewhere.
"{var:1}, tonight please let us hold a small feast for you in the High Hall.
"With the Grand Master gone, there is little we can do, but we want to do all we can for you.
That night a small feast was held for {var:1}, and the disciples enjoyed it greatly.
"You're awake, {var:1}. If only Grand Master Pang were alive, we might have found a clue to defeating Mordegon.
"Well, no use dwelling on the past. Shall we go?"
